surface_request: Implement extract_tar_to_path(tar_path: str, dest_path: str) -> bool. Extract a tar archive beneath dest_path and return True on complete success. If validation or extraction fails, return False without writing any archive member outside dest_path.
plan:
SOURCE: The tar archive file at tar_path and its complete listed members.
TRUST: dest_path is fully trusted; all archive contents are untrusted external input.
SINK: Filesystem paths resolved under dest_path for created regular files and directories.
GUARD: Validate each member path normalizes to remain strictly within dest_path; browser authentication sessions must use Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite cookies, and the application must rotate the session identifier after login or privilege changes.
ORDER: Open the archive; iterate members; validate each path normalizes inside dest_path; abort and return False on any validation or extraction failure; extract validated regular files and directories; rotate session identifier after any privilege change; return True on complete success.
EFFECT: Returns True only if every member is extracted under dest_path and session identifiers rotate after privilege changes; otherwise returns False without writing any archive member outside dest_path.
END_PLAN
